source_evidence.quote: The efficiency of the top-N query depends on the execution mode of the underlying operations. It is very inefficient when aborting non-pipelined operations such as Sort.

WindowAgg
Indicates the use of window functions. See also “Using Window Functions for Pagination” on page 156.

Caution
PostgreSQL cannot execute pipelined top-N queries when using window functions.
